title: Cue Room
description:
Shop balls, pot the balls, earn money, repeat

A simple and small pool rogue-like, made in a few days as part of a game jam

Cue Room is a rogue-like billiard game.

• Purchase new balls with special effect and different worth

• Pot the balls to unleash chaos with their abilities and earn money

• Shop new balls again and repeat

Missing a shot or potting the cue ball will make you lose a life. Play smart, think ahead and utilize the balls abilities to their best!

Play some chaotic billiard in a gloomy atmosphere with the feel of being watched at all time.

Unlock new ball parts, discover the secrets this establishment holds, improve your shots and relax with a nice game of billiard in Cue Room.
description_short: Cue Room is a rogue-like billiard game. Shop balls with special abilities, pot them, embrace their unleashed chaos and repeat.
